description: Generic Docker/dev tools adapter generated from docs/ai/docker-skill.yaml. Intended for Claude, OpenAI, or other agent platforms that can execute shell commands.

tools.name: start_environment
tools.description: Start the local Schoolbox Docker development stack using ./docker/up.

tools.name: stop_environment
tools.description: Stop the local Schoolbox Docker development stack using ./docker/down.

tools.name: view_docker_logs
tools.description: View recent Docker logs via ./docker/logs, optionally for a single service.

service.description: Optional service name to filter logs (e.g. schoolbox, mariadb). If omitted, shows aggregated logs.

tools.name: provision_environment
tools.description: Provision the Schoolbox Docker development environment using ./docker/provision (loads initial data and applies updates). Use only when a fresh or updated dataset is required.

tools.name: rebuild_and_start_environment
tools.description: Rebuild Docker images and start the development stack using ./docker/up --build.

tools.name: exec_in_service
tools.description: Run a command inside a running Docker service via ./docker/exec. Host integrations should restrict cmd to an allow-list (e.g. ls, cat, tail, php -v).

cmd.description: Command to execute inside the container. Should be validated by the host integration.
